mintAuthority.summary: CADD has issuer-native ERC20F deployments on Ethereum and Base with role-gated minting and UUPS upgrades. Both share implementation 0x0f25045d and EIP-7702 delegated role holders: minter 0x4b37dd8b, default admin 0xb3a77dd7, and upgrader 0x9367b51c. All three delegate to Fireblocks' verified UniversalGaslessDelegate; the off-chain signer custody policy remains undisclosed, and public issuer materials do not state whether cross-chain reserve ledgers are independently reconciled.

controls.label: CADD MINTER_ROLE holder (Ethereum and Base)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770164 and Base block 50062319, hasRole reads and RoleGranted logs confirm this address holds MINTER_ROLE (0x9f2df0fed...). eth_getCode on both chains returns 0xef0100 || 0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b, the EIP-7702 delegation indicator for Fireblocks' verified UniversalGaslessDelegate. The delegate validates signatures but does not disclose the private-key custody policy behind this role holder.

controls.label: CADD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder (Ethereum and Base)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770164 and Base block 50062319, hasRole reads and RoleGranted logs confirm DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by this address. eth_getCode returns the same Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate indicator on both chains. The verified implementation assigns upgrades to a distinct UPGRADER_ROLE rather than DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: CADD UPGRADER_ROLE holder (Ethereum and Base)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770164 and Base block 50062319, the verified ERC20F implementation gates _authorizeUpgrade() with UPGRADER_ROLE 0x189ab7a9.... RoleGranted history and current hasRole calls identify 0x9367b51c... as the holder on both Ethereum and Base. Both proxies resolve to implementation 0x0f25045d.... The upgrader account delegates to Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate; no timelock is present and the underlying signer custody remains undisclosed.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Base are both authored as canonical issuer-native deployments: Tetra lists CADD on each Supported Blockchain, and no bridge protocol or conservation adapter is identified. At Ethereum block 25770164 and Base block 50062319, current calls confirm 0x4b37dd8b holds MINTER_ROLE, 0xb3a77dd7 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and 0x9367b51c holds UPGRADER_ROLE on both chains; both proxies resolve to implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62. EIP-7702 code identifies Fireblocks UniversalGaslessDelegate as the common delegate implementation. That resolves the on-chain delegate and upgrade authority, but not the signer custody policy behind any of the three delegated EOAs, so confidence remains manual-review. Tetra's public materials do not state whether reserves are reconciled independently per chain or linked by an undisclosed conservation process; this classification is therefore probable rather than verified. The registry records Alberta Treasury Board and Finance under Alberta's Loan and Trust Corporations Act as the named prudential regulator.
